card.name: Small words before an expected verb
card.fires_on: Small linking or auxiliary words such as were, are, have, to, an and or in general web prose, where a verb is about to follow. The word sits right before the main verb.

modes.label: Auxiliary verbs
modes.description: Were, are or have right before a participle or verb in a passive or perfect clause.
modes.example: fixed the offending pages, and<< were>> restored to Google’s list.

modes.label: To before a verb
modes.description: The word to after begins or Designed, leading into an action verb.
modes.example: If the mouse begins<< to>> walk clockwise around the perimeter of the table

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Stray function words like an, or and a comma where the next word is open.

card.writes: It suppresses odd word fragments and mildly favors move-type verbs, so there is little clear output effect beyond verb prediction.
card.plain: It fires on little helper words just before a verb, such as were, are or to.
